name: Tova of Lanternmarsh
lore: A lantern newt who guides lost travellers through Lanternmarsh. Her reed tongue and waylights keep nearby companions fighting together.

primary.name: Reed Tap
primary.description: Aim a narrow tongue strike. The tongue and its round tip hit along the visible path for 21 damage; the most injured nearby ally (or you) heals 2 HP.

secondary.name: Waylight Steps
secondary.description: Three stepping lanterns follow behind you for 4s. Allies touching them heal 2 HP/sec and remove slow once; enemies touching them are slowed.

special.name: Marsh Haven
special.description: A five-second lantern refuge at your feet: allies heal 4 HP/sec and gain 15% protection; foes inside are slowed.

passive: Waylight Lifeblood: you and allied heroes within 160 reach heal 2 HP on a successful attack hit, at most once every 0.75 seconds per hero.

technique.name: Long Reed

attack.name: Long Reed
attack.description: Longer tongue reach, 17 damage and slower recovery; hit healing remains 2.

technique.description: Keep an ally safer from farther away, at lower damage frequency.

final_technique.name: Guiding Spirits

attack.name: Guiding Spirits
attack.description: Summon two lantern spirits for 8s. Each heals the most wounded nearby ally 2 HP/sec and taps enemies for 5.

final_technique.description: Trade a stationary team refuge for two fragile moving helpers.
